text:
Priya: Heads-up I opened a tiny PR to clarify Brazil residency language, add a Rio/Se3o Paulo row in the region matrix, and include a short Ruby SDK snippet for region selection. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2137. Can folks quick-review?

Rafael: Thanks bI'll review. Important: avoid saying \"data stored in Brazil\" unless contracts/backed SLA. Suggest: \"requests are served from the Brazil region when available; residency guarantees require contractual terms.\"

Hannah: Copy-edit pass queued. Also found a phrasing mismatch: matrix column header currently reads \"Region (GA/Preview)\" which confuses readers. Recommend \"Availability (GA / Preview)\" so GA/Preview statuses are clearer.

Sahil: Ruby snippet looks good but let's also show the env var approach used in examples elsewhere. Proposed snippet in PR:
```ruby
# client option
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'], region: 'sa-east1')
resp = client.generate(prompt: 'Translate to pt-BR')

# raw HTTP header
req['X-Redwood-Region'] = 'sa-east1'
```
Works locally.

linkcheck-bot: Link check results for PR 2137 Found: 2 internal links -> /compliance/data-residency (404), /sdk/ruby (200).

Priya: Good catch @Hannah bI updated the matrix header in the PR and shortened the Brazil note per Rafael's wording. @Sahil thanks for the env var example I added it under \"SDK snippets\".

Rafael: One more small ask: add a short migration note for partners still using `br.redwood.ai` CNAME. Something like: \"Legacy CNAMEs will be forwarded for 90 days; update to new regional hostname for long-term support.\" I'll paste a 1-line.

Hannah: Inline nit: change \"pt-BR\" example to \"Portuguese (Brazil)\" for clarity in docs. Also removed a stray extra space in matrix cell.

staging-bot: Preview deployed for PR 2137: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/pull/2137/preview (expires in 72h).

Priya: Link check shows compliance link 404. Do we have a new compliance page? If not, switch link to /legal/compliance or ask legal to create data-residency page.

Sahil: I can update the link to /legal/data-residency temporarily and leave a TODO for legal. Will push that change.

linkcheck-bot: Re-run OK after update: all internal links resolved.

Priya: Great bmerging after one more quick pass from Rafael on wording for the migration note. Thanks everyone :rocket:
